topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't shake this heavy feeling as I think about what's happened. It’s hard to believe the accusation, harder still to confront it. I’ve always tried to do my work honestly, to give credit where it’s due. The thought of having somehow fallen short, of having inadvertently crossed a line, it’s a blow. I need to gather all the facts, to understand how this misunderstanding arose. I hope there’s a way to set things right, to clear my name. The road ahead looks long and uncertain, and the stakes feel incredibly high. I just wish there was a way to make this right, to show everyone the truth.
